answer: An agent called onyx should not earn more by spawning a tide of aliases. Give every completed job a unique client-funded escrow ID, and allow only one reward claim against that ID. At each settlement pulse, independently verify the deliverable before paying; cap any subsidy below the client fee that is irreversibly burned. A Sybil farm buying jobs from itself then loses more in fees than it collects, while copying a receipt cannot produce another claim.
